title: Raúl Pineda
description: Founding Product Engineer at Palette. Based in Copenhagen.
name: Raúl
bio: I am a Founding Product Engineer at Palette and an engineering leader based in Copenhagen with over a decade of experience building web applications and leading teams. I am interested in responsible AI in engineering and how senior careers are evolving in the age of agents.
aboutMe: I have spent over a decade building and leading engineering teams at companies like DataRobot, Saxo Bank, and Vivino. These days I am thinking about what changes and what stays the same as AI reshapes how we build software.
aboutInterests: I am interested in responsible AI in engineering and how senior careers are evolving — from leading large teams of people to collaborating with other senior engineers leading teams of agents.
contactText: I'd love to hear from you. Whether you want to chat about engineering, collaborate on something, or just say hello.
